title: Calibrate printed sewing patterns
problem: A home sewer measures a printed pattern and finds that it came out larger than the intended size.
workaround: Print at actual size, check the test square with a ruler, then adjust printer scale and print again if needed.
gap: When the measured square is still off, calculate the exact scale from the measured and intended lengths. Give the user a single calibration page to print before risking the whole pattern.

title: Review possible duplicates before merging two lists
problem: A spreadsheet beginner needs to screen recurring imports of hundreds of rows, review ambiguous matches, and keep a clean master list.
workaround: Maintain a workbook macro or set up Power Query, then review potential matches before writing them to the master list.
gap: Give the user a reusable offline review step with pasted spreadsheet rows, a review queue for near matches and a downloadable merged result. Keep IDs and same-name records distinct until the user decides.
